content: ASP.NET Core 8 Kestrel serves a built SPA via UseStaticFiles() pointed at wwwroot (or a custom outDir path) with MapFallbackToFile/MapFallbackToPage for client-side routing. Standard pattern: set Vite's build.outDir to the orchestrator's wwwroot (or a subfolder), run 'npm run build' as a Dockerfile build stage, COPY only the built dist/ output into the final image -- Node/npm itself never ships in the runtime image, only the static output. This preserves single-container deployment while adding a Node build stage to the Dockerfile (multi-stage build), which is the actual air-gapped-relevant tradeoff versus v3.0's zero-build htmx approach.
